function pad(width = 4, text: string) {
  const size: number = width;
  return text.padStart(size, ".");
}
const explicit: (width: number | undefined, text: string) => string = pad;
console.log(explicit(undefined, "ab"));
console.log(pad(6, "ab"));
console.log(pad.length);
function range(start = 0, end: number, step = 1) {
  const values: number[] = [];
  for (let value = start; value < end; value += step) values.push(value);
  return values;
}
const twoArgs: (start: number | undefined, end: number) => number[] = range;
console.log(twoArgs(undefined, 3).join(","));
console.log(range(1, 9, 3).join(","));
type RangeParameters = Parameters<typeof range>;
const parameters: RangeParameters = [undefined, 5];
console.log(range(...parameters).length);
